summary: Daniel Bayda discusses the concept of the Mishkan in Parashat Teruma and its connection to the hidden presence of Hashem in the story of Purim. He explains how the Rambam in Sefer Ben Hashit describes the piece of Hashem within each person and how this relates to our ability to act as a light unto other nations.
questions: How can we build a place for Hashem if He is not a physical being?
What does it mean to have a piece of Hashem inside of us?
How is Hashem present in the story of Purim despite His name not appearing in the Megillah?
How can we use our intellectual abilities to connect with Hashem?
